description: This file defines a React context provider component for handling file drag-and-drop operations within a web application. It manages drag events, overlays, and file uploads, and exposes context methods for child components to participate in drag-and-drop interactions.

classes.name: FileDragNDropProvider
classes.description: A React component that provides context for managing drag-and-drop file uploads, including visual overlay management and callback handling.

methods.name: addDragTarget
methods.description: Registers a DOM element as a drag target with associated callback data.

methods.name: removeDragTarget
methods.description: Removes a DOM element from being a drag target.
